OK 1 Mahe The largest island and most populated in the Seychelles archipelago, Mahé is also the home to the nation’s charming colonial capital, Victoria. Here it’s all about the palm-fringed white sand beaches breathtaking bays and sandy coves that rise to granite peaks including the rainforested Morne Seychellois. The most developed island in the Seychelles archipelago, it has colourful creole architecture, a bustling little market, Botanical Gardens and National Museum of History. The majority of Mahé's accommodation is strung along its stunning coastline, with Beau Vallon in the north-west offering not only a wide variety of hotels and self-catering apartments, but also the largest selection of restaurants and nightlife.
